title: Where the house stands
md:
the house enters the second half of 2026 at what it has itself called the low point of the cycle. FY2025 closed at €14.7bn of revenue, down 13% reported, and in a net loss after three years of decline. Gucci — 38% of revenue, roughly 60% of recurring operating income — shrank a further 8% organically in the first quarter, and the group's own diagnosis of its China problem is unusually candid: *over-distribution and low cultural relevance*.

The counterpart on Wednesday is Luca the CEO, in the seat since September 2025 and the group's first external CEO. He is a marketing-native operator who names his turnarounds; the current one is Reconthe house, which rebuilds operations by 2028 and position by 2030. Half-year results land one week after the meeting, so expect a careful reader in pre-results mode.

title: Three fields, and the missing fourth
md:
At the April 2026 Capital Markets Day the CEO stated the group's AI programme in one sentence: *follow the client, follow the product, follow the money — these are the three fields of application for AI.* The programme is real: a Chief AI Officer, Google partnerships, and Gucci named as the group's official AI laboratory.

Read against the working paper's five levels — group philosophy, house codes, collection architecture, product, and the discourse around them — the three fields all sit at or below the product line. Nothing in the announced stack holds the house's meaning as a structure that a move can be read against. That is the fourth field, and it is the only one of the four not yet occupied by a vendor, a partner or an internal team.

title: What Reconthe house already commits to
md:
Three announced resets can be read against the structure today: the store network from roughly 600 doors to 450; leather-goods priority in the Gucci architecture; and the see-now-buy-now cadence tested in September 2025. Figure 2 reads the first of these across the five levels. The read is the point: the network cut *reinforces* house codes (scarcity is the exclusivity code enacted in distribution) and collection architecture, leaves philosophy and product untouched, and *strains* the discourse — fewer doors is a story the trade press tells as retreat unless the house tells it first.

None of this requires the instrument to decide anything. It says which level a move reinforces, which it strains, and what the record shows the last time the house did this.

title: The risks in the framing
md: The briefing flags eight ways the pitch could misfire; table 2 carries the three that matter. Two are about register: luxury sells scarce genius, so *democratizing* is the wrong verb, and anything customer-facing is reputationally radioactive in fashion this year. The third is about evidence: the "Gucci GPT" story is single-source and unverified, and a counterpart in pre-results mode will know it.

title: What to say on Wednesday
md:
Open with his sentence, not ours. Client, product, money — and then the fourth field, named in his register: an instrument that helps the creative people get better, faster, stronger, held strictly backstage. Show one reset read against five levels (figure 2) and one table of the situation on the record (table 1). Do not show the model; show the read.

Ask for one house and one season as the first laboratory. Gucci is already designated as the group's AI laboratory; the fourth field is the layer his programme is missing, not a competitor to it.
